tracking: VCD off; coverage off; profiling off; recorder and validation outside phase timing

equivalence.checks: Baseline/current and native reference behavior match; source imports guarded; native library identical.

validation_commit.checks: Independent source/log/behavior/statistics acceptance, strict Sphinx, lint and diff checks passed; final results and tracker committed together.

stop_rule: One fixed round. Stop on timeout or behavior mismatch; publish failures. No optimization or extra workload.
retained_preparation_issues: Initial recorder five-minute timeout; all 30 completed samples retained, original 30-minute deadline preserved.
Initial strict docs check lacked progress-page navigation entry; added to development index and strict build passed.
